github.instruction:
Action required: Share the following authentication link with the user to complete setup for 'github'.

Authentication Link (render clickable):
https://connect.composio.dev/link/lk_3TBeV3yQTxNN

What happens next:
1) User opens the link in their browser. They will see a Composio branded authentication UI.
2) For OAuth: user authorizes with the provider.
3) For API/Token auth: User enters the required credentials in the form.
4) The connection becomes Active automatically once completed.

Important Notes:
- Always show the returned redirect_url as a FORMATTED MARKDOWN LINK in your final response for this turn as intermediate messages may be hidden or summarized by the chat interface, so the user may not see the link there. Ask the user to click on the link to finish authentication and reply when done.
- DO NOT execute any github tools until an Active connection is confirmed.
- After the user replies, call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS with action="list" and check that the newly added account is active before continuing.
- Render as clickable link: [Connect github](https://connect.composio.dev/link/lk_3TBeV3yQTxNN).
- The above link expires in 10 minutes.
